faqs.question: What does Promonet connect?
faqs.answer: We help small businesses connect CRM platforms like Capsule, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Copper, and Insightly to accounting, booking, and industry software — plus many other tools in your stack.

faqs.question: Is Promonet for small businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Promonet is built for owners and small teams who need CRM and tool integrations without hiring a full-time development team.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to connect tools?
faqs.answer: Monthly partnerships start at £600. Scale-up is £1,500 per month. A one-off connection starts at £1,000. Custom work is quoted separately.

faqs.question: How long does a typical integration take?
faqs.answer: After a get-to-know-you call and fixed quote, most builds take two to four weeks, then we monitor and maintain the connections.

faqs.question: Do I need developers on my team?
faqs.answer: No. We map, build, document, and maintain the connections for you, with human support when something needs a tweak.

about.title: Built by people who've lived the connectivity gap.
about.p1: We help small businesses connect CRM and industry tools at a low cost, with genuine human support — so owners stop re-typing data between systems.
about.p2: We're a small team of developers and designers. Over 20 years building some of the leading CRM solutions, we kept seeing the same thing: customers still struggling to connect their CRM to the rest of their tools — and their tools to each other, not just the CRM.
about.storyTitle: We saw a gap. Then we decided to fill it.
about.storyP1: Businesses buy great software, then spend Sunday nights copying data between systems that were never meant to talk. Agencies quote enterprise prices. Support becomes a ticket queue.
about.storyP2: Promonet exists to help small businesses fix that problem — at a low cost, with genuine human support.
about.stat1Body: Building CRM products and watching connectivity stay the unsolved part of the stack.
about.stat2Body: Fixed monthly partnerships or one-off builds — priced for small businesses, not enterprise RFPs.
about.stat3Body: Real people who know your tools. No account managers. No black-hole ticket queues.
about.ctaBody: Tell us which tools you're using. We'll help you connect them — simply, affordably, with humans on the other end.
